brand_notes: NHT (Now Hear This), Benicia CA; founders left; sealed-box tradition. Own web store sells singles (C 3 $624.99 ea; SuperZero 2.1 $134.99 ea); Chinese-made (asr-nht-c3). C3 is successor to Classic Three (hometheaterhifi-nht-c3). Current store also lists C1, SuperOne 2.1, C4, MS series, in-wall/ceiling. SB2 not listed (discontinued). Possible damaged ASR sample (users-nht-c3).
takeaways: ASR Klippel: LW ±1.8 dB, f3 61 Hz, 83.1 dB vs 87 dB claimed, pref 4.5/6.9
Min impedance 4.2 Ω on a 6 Ω rating (below-iec)
86 dB THD very low, 96 dB breaks down above ~7 kHz
Secrets outdoor measurements found it far flatter than ASR; ASR sample possibly damaged
Critics: neutral, fast, great imaging, lean bass, wants a sub
conflicts: ASR wavy/bright on-axis vs Secrets 'superbly flat' (possible damaged ASR sample)
Claimed 45 Hz FR vs f3 61 Hz
